types.description: Harmony XB4 body/fixing collar, green integral LED 24 V AC/DC direct supply, one NO and one NC contact; operator head separate

document.title: Schneider Electric ZB4BW0B35 product data sheet, including manufacturer-assigned product illustrations
document.revision: Printed September 12, 2026; legacy identity independently confirmed by November 11, 2015 sheet and 10/2021 catalog
document.pages: pp.1-2 characteristics; p.7 printed NO 3-4 block schematic; p.8 rear NC 1/2, NO 3/4 and LED X1/X2 markings; pp.7-9 are family illustrations assigned to the exact-order sheet

modelingNotes: Source order ZB4-BW0B35 is the presentation-hyphen form of manufacturer ZB4BW0B35. The exact November 11, 2015 sheet and Harmony XB4 catalog 10/2021 physical p.86/printed p.84 establish a complete body/contact/light assembly: Zamak fixing collar, one NO, one NC and green protected integral LED, direct 24 V AC/DC 50/60 Hz. The operator head is excluded; additional contact blocks are optional, not included in the modeled factory inventory. A full service-parts SKU bill of materials is not established.

Physical field keys follow the manufacturer-assigned rear illustration in the exact current ZB4BW0B35 sheet p.8: NC 1/2, NO 3/4, LED X1/X2. Page 7 shows the printed NO 3-4 schematic. These alternate/family image assets include sibling reference names B55/B65/G35; they are evidence of the illustrated constituent-block interface, not an inspected B35 production specimen. Exact B35 composition and lamp rating are independently established by the exact selection row.

Published naming discrepancy: the exact historical/current datasheet ISO terminal-description field says (11-12) NC, whereas the manufacturer-assigned physical illustration marks NC 1/2. The model does not create an additional NC pair or silently alias ISO 11/12 to 1/2, and does not infer NO 13/14 from IEC convention. Reconcile these image-derived keys with actual installed markings before installation use.

NC 1-2 is normally closed and NO 3-4 normally open with each block plunger unoperated. The separate head/cam and contact position determine actuation. Catalog physical p.32/printed p.30 combines this body with pushbutton head ZB4BW333; physical p.60/printed p.58 also uses this body with selector heads. No unconditional simultaneous gang, spring return, maintained action or lamp/contact actuation relation belongs to the headless body. Generic contact symbols express the bounded functions.

Three independent two-terminal electrical functions are modeled: one NC contact, one NO contact and one LED load. No fixed internal links or common nodes are authored. A contact state or LED load is not a permanent short; mechanical attachment between blocks does not create electrical continuity.

Lamp functional supply: direct 24 V AC/DC 50/60 Hz, steady green; limits 19.2-30 V DC and 21.6-26.4 V AC, consumption 18 mA. No AC-only or DC-only scalar is assigned. Schneider ZBV family FAQ FA319072 recommends DC positive on X1 and negative on X2 for consistency, while qualifying its polarity-insensitivity statement as applying to most units. This is a recommended convention, not exact B35 proof of arbitrary DC polarity or a hard polarity-sensitive claim.

Contacts are optional/application-dependent. Requiring X1 and X2 is explicit library policy for use of the modeled functioning lamp, not a manufacturer statement that every application must energize it.

Conditional contact capabilities remain notes: Ith 10 A; Ui 600 V at pollution degree 3; Uimp 6 kV; AC-15 6 A at 120 V, 3 A at 240 V, 1.2 A at 600 V; DC-13 0.55 A at 125 V, 0.27 A at 250 V, 0.1 A at 600 V. Exact sheet specifies positive opening per EN/IEC 60947-5-1 Appendix K and 10 A gG short-circuit protection; neither establishes the safety of an arbitrary installed head/circuit. No capability is assigned as an exact operating scalar.

Screw-clamp torque 0.8-1.2 N m per exact sheet. Wire statements preserve their count/preparation qualifiers: at least one 0.22 mm2 conductor without end sleeve and at most two 1.5 mm2 conductors with end sleeves. They are not flattened into an unconditional wire range.

Physical/bonding coverage is partial. Exact sheet declares Class I and a Zamak collar; Schneider XB4/ZB4 mounting FAQ FA284040 calls the collar fixing screw the grounding screw. Exact-product-linked instruction 155997103A55 (W915599710311A08, 01/2011, p.1) depicts collar mounting and contact clipping. The opened evidence does not establish a separately labeled PE field terminal/conductor inventory. No invented PE terminal, automatic panel/head bond, or assertion that no bonding provision exists is made.

connectionCoverage.notes: Six illustrated field terminals are modeled: NC 1/2, NO 3/4 and LED X1/X2. The manufacturer assigns family images to the exact-order sheet; its separate ISO field says NC 11-12. Actual installed marks need reconciliation. Known collar grounding/mounting access is not resolved into a labeled PE conductor inventory, and no automatic bond is modeled. The selected head, any added contact blocks and any disassembled internal interfaces are outside the modeled factory assembly.
